base_instruction: Same woman, identical face, same facial features, freckles and skin texture, same hair, same outfit, same framing and camera distance. Raw unretouched skin, realistic photograph, no beauty filter.

lighting.red_moody: Change the lighting to deep red moody light, strong shadows on one side of the face, dark background.
lighting.blue_night: Change the lighting to cold blue night light with soft falloff and deep shadows.
lighting.harsh_flash: Change the lighting to a harsh direct on-camera flash, hard shadow behind her, slightly overexposed skin highlights.
lighting.chiaroscuro: Change the lighting to dramatic chiaroscuro: a single hard light from the side, half the face in deep shadow.
lighting.golden_window: Change the lighting to warm golden window light raking across the face.
lighting.candlelight: Change the lighting so the only light comes from a warm oil lamp or candle beside her, glowing amber on one side of her face, the rest of the room falling into deep shadow.

pose.head_turn: She turns her head slightly to the side, eyes still on the camera.
pose.chin_down: She lowers her chin slightly and looks up into the lens.
pose.hand_to_face: She raises one hand gently to her cheek.
pose.look_away: She glances slightly away from the camera.

clip_prompt: Smooth, slow cinematic transition. The light gradually shifts and she moves naturally. Her face stays identical throughout.
clip_negative_prompt: face morphing, distorted face, extra fingers, warped hands, flicker
